description: Machine-readable backend error identity. A code is a stable, language-independent identifier the frontend maps to presentation; the backend never ships display language beyond a developer-facing English message. Codes are `<namespace>.<reason>`, namespaces come from the domain registry (domains[].errorNamespace).
rules: A code is stable once published. Renaming or removing a code is a BREAKING change (see contract-lock.json).
A code's namespace must equal an errorNamespace declared in manifest/domains.json.
`status` is the HTTP status the compatibility layer emits for the code.
Message text is developer-facing English only. Localisation is the frontend's job (future Translation LEGO) and must key off `code`, never off the message string.
Adding a new code is a MINOR change; changing an existing code's `status` is BREAKING.

statusSemantics.404: the addressed entity does not exist
statusSemantics.501: the capability is known but not implemented on this instance
